title: Prince William Reveals the Surprising Celebrity He Was Mistaken for During Latest Royal Outing

 “One lovely gentleman looked up at me from his seat and said, ‘When are you going to sing?’”
 Juliana Ukiomogbe Wed, 28 October 2026 at 9:34 pm UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Credit: Matthew Horwood/Getty Images The Gist
 Prince William revealed that he was mistaken for the late singer Prince during a recent appearance.
 "I went to a place in Somerset and was looking around some of the local communities there, and one lovely gentleman looked up at me from his seat and said, 'When are you going to sing?'" he later recalled.
 The Prince of Wales continued, "It turned out he wanted me to sing 'Purple Rain,' which I don't know the lyrics for."
 Prince William was mistaken for a surprising celebrity during one of his latest royal outings.
 On October 6, the Prince of Wales visited Sweet Surprise café in Ilminster, Somerset, where a man mistook him for the late singer Prince , who died in 2016.
 Prince William at Sweet Surprise on October 6, 2026. 
 Credit: Getty Images 
 "I went to a place in Somerset and was looking around some of the local communities there, and one lovely gentleman looked up at me from his seat and said, 'When are you going to sing?'" William later recalled during an October 23 appearance on The Graham Norton Show , per People . The episode also featured Cate Blanchett , Hannah Waddingham , and Robert Irwin .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement William continued, "I've had many requests over many years from all ranging parts of society, and I said, 'I'm sorry, what do you mean?' He goes, 'When are you going to sing your performance?' and the lady behind tapped his arm and went, 'No, no, he's not that prince.' It turned out he wanted me to sing 'Purple Rain,' which I don't know the lyrics for."
 Prince performing during the Purple Rain Tour in 1984. 
 Credit: Getty Images 
 On October 27, the man's mother spoke with The Sun about the mix-up.
 "To be ­honest, I don't think Sebastian had any idea who Prince William was — but he's a massive fan of Prince the singer and can list all his songs and knows all the lyrics," she said.
 "Considering his learning difficulties, it is amazing," she added about her son. (Sebastian has Rubinstein-Taybi Syndrome, a rare genetic disorder). "So when Prince William arrived at Sweet Surprise, Sebastian assumed it was Prince the singer!"
 Prince William on October 21, 2026. 
 Credit: Matthew Horwood/Getty Images 
 She also revealed that Sebastian wrote an apology letter to William. "In it, he thanks William for visiting and has apologised for mistaking him for Prince," she said. "We hope he sees it."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Elsewhere on The Graham Norton Show , and in a similar musical vein, William shared that he once considered becoming a DJ.
 "I went through a phase where I wanted to be a DJ, which didn't go very well," he said. He even came up with a stage name: DJ Xara. "It wasn't good," he joked.
